# mondoo_integration_jira (Resource)

Integrate the Jira ticket system with Mondoo to automatically create and close Jira issues based on Mondoo findings. Create it in a Mondoo organization (`org_id`), whose spaces can all file tickets through it, or in a space (`space_id`). An organization integration cannot auto-create tickets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "jira_token" {
  description = "The Jira API Token"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

provider "mondoo" {
  space = "hungry-poet-123456"
}

# Set up the Jira integration
resource "mondoo_integration_jira" "jira_integration" {
  name  = "My Jira Integration"
  host  = "https://your-instance.atlassian.net"
  email = "jira.owner@email.com"
  # default_project = "MONDOO"

  auto_create = true
  auto_close  = true

  credentials = {
    token = var.jira_token
  }
}

# Or set it up once for the organization: every space of the organization can
# file tickets through it. An organization integration cannot set auto_create.
resource "mondoo_integration_jira" "org_jira_integration" {
  org_id = "your-org-1234567"
  name   = "Organization Jira"
  host   = "https://your-instance.atlassian.net"
  email  = "jira.owner@email.com"

  auto_close = true

  credentials = {
    token = var.jira_token
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `email` (String) Jira user email.
- `host` (String) Jira host URL.
- `name` (String) Name of the integration.

### Optional

- `auto_close` (Boolean) Automatically close Jira issues for resolved Mondoo findings.
- `auto_create` (Boolean) Automatically create Jira issues for Mondoo findings. This corresponds to the **'Create drift issues in this integration'** toggle in the Mondoo Console.
- `default_project` (String) Default Jira project (represented by the project key, such as `SEC` or `SECURITY`). This corresponds to the **'Select a default drift issue destination'** dropdown in the Mondoo Console.
- `org_id` (String) Mondoo organization identifier. Set this to create the integration in the organization. Conflicts with `space_id`.
- `space_id` (String) Mondoo space identifier. If neither `space_id` nor `org_id` is set, the provider space is used.

### Read-Only

- `mrn` (String) Integration identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Jira API token.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using integration MRN.
terraform import mondoo_integration_jira.jira_integration "//captain.api.mondoo.app/spaces/hungry-poet-123456/integrations/2Abd08lk860"
```
